title: The Hundredth Piece
logline: In a hill-country kitchen before the New Year, a sweet-maker's hands move without looking, and a child's whole day depends on the first bite.

object.note: Object 2 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: From a feast's second and third helpings to a kitchen before the New Year, where the maker's hands no longer need to look and a child's day hangs on the first bite.

thread_out.thread: The same New Year season, far to the north: after the sweets, the new clothes, and the different reasons people give for wanting them.

requirements: A family actively making traditional sweets for the New Year
Consent to film children in a home setting, from parents or guardians
A kitchen with room for close, unobtrusive filming

suggestions.name: A village home kitchen near Badulla
suggestions.why: A hill-country district with strong village New Year traditions.
